panels.title: 失敗率（成員 × repo；failed+errored / (total - canceled)）
panels.description: 排除 is_post_merge 與 is_deploy_event。對照月報第 1 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH agg AS (SELECT member, repo, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denom, SUM(CASE WHEN is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fails FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND member IN (${member:singlequote}) AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event GROUP BY member, repo), overall AS (SELECT member, 'Overall' AS repo, SUM(denom) AS denom, SUM(fails) AS fails FROM agg GROUP BY member) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN denom > 0 THEN CONCAT(fails, '/', denom, ' (', ROUND(fails * 100.0 / denom, 1), '%)') ELSE '-' END AS rate FROM (SELECT member, repo, denom, fails, 0 AS ord FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT member, repo, denom, fails, 1 AS ord FROM overall) combined ORDER BY member, ord, repo

panels.title: 失敗成本（成員 × repo；GHA Linux $0.008/min）
panels.description: (failed+errored) duration 加總 × $0.008/min。canceled 不計。對照月報第 2 表。

targets.rawSql: SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED' THEN duration_seconds ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CONCAT('$', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED' THEN duration_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 * 0.008, 2)) ELSE '-' END AS cost FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND member IN (${member:singlequote}) AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event GROUP BY member, repo ORDER BY member, repo

panels.title: PR 迭代次數（成員 × repo；builds / PRs）
panels.description: 理想 = 1.0；越高代表 PR 反覆推 commit。對照月報第 3 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH pr_builds AS (SELECT member, repo, pr_number, COUNT(*) AS build_count FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND member IN (${member:singlequote}) AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND is_pull_request AND pr_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY member, repo, pr_number), agg AS (SELECT member, repo, SUM(build_count) AS builds, COUNT(*) AS prs FROM pr_builds GROUP BY member, repo) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN prs > 0 THEN CONCAT(builds, '/', prs, ' (', ROUND(builds * 1.0 / prs, 1), ')') ELSE '-' END AS iteration FROM agg ORDER BY member, repo

panels.title: PR size × Review latency（中位 / p90 / p100，含未 review lower bound，小時）
panels.description: 對照月報第 4 表。未 review PR 用「now（或月底）- ready_at」當 lower bound。

targets.rawSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT size_bucket, lat_h, unreviewed, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY size_bucket ORDER BY lat_h) AS pr_b, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lat_h) AS pr_a FROM dpv_pr_latency WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo()), per_bucket AS (SELECT size_bucket AS bucket, CONCAT(ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN pr_b >= 0.5 THEN lat_h END), 1), 'h') AS median, CONCAT(ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN pr_b >= 0.9 THEN lat_h END), 1), 'h') AS p90, CONCAT(ROUND(MAX(lat_h), 1), 'h') AS p100, CONCAT('', COUNT(*)) AS n, NULLIF(CONCAT('', SUM(CASE WHEN unreviewed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)), '0') AS unreviewed FROM ranked GROUP BY size_bucket), overall AS (SELECT 'Overall' AS bucket, CONCAT(ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN pr_a >= 0.5 THEN lat_h END), 1), 'h') AS median, CONCAT(ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN pr_a >= 0.9 THEN lat_h END), 1), 'h') AS p90, CONCAT(ROUND(MAX(lat_h), 1), 'h') AS p100, CONCAT('', COUNT(*)) AS n, NULLIF(CONCAT('', SUM(CASE WHEN unreviewed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)), '0') AS unreviewed FROM ranked) SELECT * FROM per_bucket UNION ALL SELECT * FROM overall ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 WHEN 'Overall' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: PR Lifecycle p90（Pickup / Approval / Merge，小時）

targets.rawSql: SELECT pr_created_at AS created, member, repo, number AS pr_number, size_bucket AS size, ROUND(lat_h, 1) AS latency_h, CASE WHEN closed_at IS NULL AND merged_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opening, CONCAT('https://github.com/', repo, '/pull/', number) AS url FROM dpv_pr_latency WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND member IN (${member:singlequote}) AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() ORDER BY latency_h DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: PR review latency（成員 × size；中位 / p90 (n=N)，小時）

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT size_bucket, pickup_h, approval_h, merge_h FROM dpv_pr_latency WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo()), pu_p90 AS (SELECT size_bucket, MIN(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(cnt * 0.9) THEN pickup_h END) AS val FROM (SELECT size_bucket, pickup_h, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY size_bucket ORDER BY pickup_h) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY size_bucket) AS cnt FROM base WHERE pickup_h IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY size_bucket), ap_p90 AS (SELECT size_bucket, MIN(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(cnt * 0.9) THEN approval_h END) AS val FROM (SELECT size_bucket, approval_h, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY size_bucket ORDER BY approval_h) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY size_bucket) AS cnt FROM base WHERE approval_h IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY size_bucket), mg_p90 AS (SELECT size_bucket, MIN(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(cnt * 0.9) THEN merge_h END) AS val FROM (SELECT size_bucket, merge_h, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY size_bucket ORDER BY merge_h) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY size_bucket) AS cnt FROM base WHERE merge_h IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY size_bucket), pu_all AS (SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(cnt * 0.9) THEN pickup_h END) AS val FROM (SELECT pickup_h, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pickup_h) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM base WHERE pickup_h IS NOT NULL) t), ap_all AS (SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(cnt * 0.9) THEN approval_h END) AS val FROM (SELECT approval_h, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY approval_h) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM base WHERE approval_h IS NOT NULL) t), mg_all AS (SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(cnt * 0.9) THEN merge_h END) AS val FROM (SELECT merge_h, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY merge_h) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM base WHERE merge_h IS NOT NULL) t), per_bucket AS (SELECT c.size_bucket AS bucket, pu.val AS pu_raw, ap.val AS ap_raw, mg.val AS mg_raw, CONCAT('', c.n) AS n FROM (SELECT size_bucket, COUNT(*) AS n FROM base GROUP BY size_bucket) c LEFT JOIN pu_p90 pu ON pu.size_bucket = c.size_bucket LEFT JOIN ap_p90 ap ON ap.size_bucket = c.size_bucket LEFT JOIN mg_p90 mg ON mg.size_bucket = c.size_bucket), overall AS (SELECT 'Overall' AS bucket, pu.val AS pu_raw, ap.val AS ap_raw, mg.val AS mg_raw, (SELECT CONCAT('', COUNT(*)) FROM base) AS n FROM pu_all pu, ap_all ap, mg_all mg), combined AS (SELECT * FROM per_bucket UNION ALL SELECT * FROM overall) SELECT bucket, CASE WHEN pu_raw IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN pu_raw < 24 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(pu_raw, 1), 'h') ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(pu_raw / 24.0, 1), 'd') END AS pickup_p90, CASE WHEN ap_raw IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN ap_raw < 24 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(ap_raw, 1), 'h') ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(ap_raw / 24.0, 1), 'd') END AS approval_p90, CASE WHEN mg_raw IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN mg_raw < 24 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(mg_raw, 1), 'h') ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(mg_raw / 24.0, 1), 'd') END AS merge_p90, n FROM combined ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 WHEN 'Overall' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: PR Review latency 週趨勢（各 size bucket median，小時）
panels.description: 每週各 size bucket 的 median review latency，含未 review lower bound。

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, repo AS metric, median_min AS value FROM dpv_build_duration_daily WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND day >= $__timeFrom() AND day < $__timeTo() ORDER BY time

panels.title: 每日 passed build 中位時間（每 repo 一條，分鐘）
panels.description: 對照月報第 6 項。passed only，不過濾成員。

targets.rawSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT member, size_bucket, lat_h, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY member, size_bucket ORDER BY lat_h) AS pr FROM dpv_pr_latency WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND member IN (${member:singlequote}) AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo()) SELECT member, size_bucket, CONCAT(ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.5 THEN lat_h END), 1), 'h/', ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.9 THEN lat_h END), 1), 'h (n=', COUNT(*), ')') AS cell FROM ranked GROUP BY member, size_bucket ORDER BY member, CASE size_bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: 失敗 build 清單（無 cause）
panels.description: 對照月報第 7 項。cause 分類待 schema + classifier 接入後再加。

targets.rawSql: SELECT week AS time, size_bucket AS metric, median_h AS value FROM dpv_pr_latency_weekly WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND week >= $__timeFrom() AND week < $__timeTo() ORDER BY time

panels.title: 成員互 Approve 矩陣（approved PR 數）
panels.description: 列：reviewer，欄：PR 作者。同一 PR 同一 reviewer 多次 approve 只算一次。

targets.rawSql: SELECT reviewer, author, COUNT(DISTINCT pr_id) AS approved_prs FROM dpv_reviews WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND state = 'approved' GROUP BY reviewer, author ORDER BY reviewer, author

panels.title: 善心人士排行（群組內成員 comment 數，不含 AI 帳號）
panels.description: 統計群組內成員在其他成員 PR 上的 commented review 數，由多到少排列。

targets.rawSql: SELECT reviewer, COUNT(*) AS comments FROM dpv_reviews WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND state = 'commented' AND reviewer_account NOT LIKE '%[bot]%' AND reviewer_account <> author_account GROUP BY reviewer ORDER BY comments DESC

panels.title: 高延遲 PR 清單（review latency 由高到低）
panels.description: 含未 review PR（lower bound）。latency_h 欄位點擊可開啟 GitHub PR。

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS "date", member, repo, status AS "state", external_id AS "build", branch, duration_seconds / 60.0 AS "duration_min", CASE WHEN status <> 'CANCELED' THEN duration_seconds / 60.0 * 0.008 ELSE 0 END AS "cost_usd" FROM dpv_builds WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND member IN (${member:singlequote}) AND started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND started_at < $__timeTo() AND is_failure AND NOT is_post_merge AND NOT is_deploy_event ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: 成員失敗率週趨勢（overall，%）
panels.description: 每人每週的 overall 失敗率（跨所有 repo）。排除 is_post_merge 與 is_deploy_event。

targets.rawSql: SELECT week AS time, member AS metric, CASE WHEN denom > 0 THEN ROUND(fails * 100.0 / denom, 1) ELSE NULL END AS value FROM dpv_failure_rate_weekly WHERE group_slug IN (${group:singlequote}) AND member IN (${member:singlequote}) AND week >= $__timeFrom() AND week < $__timeTo() ORDER BY time, metric

list.query: SELECT slug FROM dp_groups ORDER BY slug

list.label: Member
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT display_name FROM dp_members m JOIN dp_groups_members gm ON gm.member_id = m.id JOIN dp_groups g ON g.id = gm.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT display_name FROM dp_members m JOIN dp_groups_members gm ON gm.member_id = m.id JOIN dp_groups g ON g.id = gm.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') ORDER BY 1
